meta.name: pi-planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多步任务的计划、发现与进度存到文件,中断后接着推进
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 AI 做长任务时常丢上下文,你想让它自己记住计划与进度
copy.tagline_en: Save multi-step AI task plans and progress to files, resuming after a break
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your AI loses context mid-task and you want plans and progress kept.

howto.what: Claude 会在你的项目里建 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md 三个文件，把计划、发现、进度写到磁盘，每完成一阶段就更新、出错也记录，/clear 后可按文件恢复。
howto.when: 当你要做需要 5 次以上工具调用的多步任务、研究或项目，或让你拆解、规划任务时触发。简单提问和单文件修改不适用。

say.text: 先建好 task_plan.md，把这个多步任务拆成阶段再动手。
say.note: 它会先写计划文件再开始执行。

say.text: 把这次搜索到的内容写进 findings.md，然后接着下一阶段。
say.note: 结果会落到磁盘而不是只留在上下文里。

say.text: /clear 之后读取我的规划文件，恢复上次的进度。
say.note: 按磁盘文件重建上下文。

howto.what_en: Claude creates task_plan.md, findings.md and progress.md in your project, writes the plan, findings and progress to disk, updates after each phase, logs errors, and can rebuild context from those files after /clear.
howto.when_en: Triggered for multi-step work needing 5+ tool calls, such as research, planning or breaking down a project. Simple questions and single-file edits don't need it.

say_en.text: Create task_plan.md first, then break this multi-step task into phases.
say_en.note: It builds the plan file before starting work.

say_en.text: Save what you found into findings.md, then move to the next phase.
say_en.note: Findings land on disk, not only in context.

say_en.text: After /clear, read my planning files and resume where we left off.
say_en.note: Context is rebuilt from the files on disk.
